symptom: describe → exec of a Studio Pro page reported Replaced although nothing was lost (JTSBootLogboek.Home_Native): only the order of its two layout arguments and of English/Dutch translations changed. mx check 0 errors before and after, so the only trace is a rewritten unit in git
cause: Two independent reorders, each enough to defeat no-op elision because canon renders lists in order. (1) buildLayoutCallArguments always put Main first, while describe prints `placeholder` blocks in stored order — a stored [Header, Main] came back [Main, Header]. (2) CarryTranslations' mergeText kept the rebuilt language first and appended the stored others via sortedLangs, so [nl_NL, en_US] came back [en_US, nl_NL] and en_US,fr_FR,nl_NL,de_DE came back sorted
insight: A carry or rebuild that sorts for determinism is still a reorder: any list the canonical form compares positionally must come back in the STORED order, and the stored document is the only deterministic source of it. Tally the stored orders before assuming one — 129 texts in PedApp/TestApp are Dutch first and multi-language texts are in addition order, never sorted; the fixtures happen to hide it because their default language is usually first. When one symptom has two causes, revert each fix separately: here either revert alone still printed 'Replaced page', which is what proves both are needed. GetPut tests only bite on a Studio Pro-shaped document — create through mxcli, BSON-patch the order Studio Pro stores, then describe → exec
